curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When Fagin’s unpaid debts put his makeshift crew in genuine danger, can an inexperienced kitten help keep the pack afloat?
curatedMovie.description: An orange runt kitten finds unlikely dog companions on New York City’s rough streets, where Fagin’s debts threaten their survival.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Light, exciting animated comedy with steady momentum and an easy watch footprint.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This animated family comedy follows a small kitten and an unlikely group of dog companions through a rough city predicament.
